name: dalga-qa
description: Autonomous Playwright QA agent for the DALGA DESIGN website

scripts.qa: npm run qa:fixtures && playwright test; npm run qa:report
scripts.qa:mobile: npm run qa:fixtures && playwright test --project=mobile-375 --project=mobile-390; npm run qa:report
scripts.qa:desktop: npm run qa:fixtures && playwright test --project=desktop-1440 --project=desktop-1920; npm run qa:report
scripts.qa:tablet: npm run qa:fixtures && playwright test --project=tablet-768; npm run qa:report
